By Raast or bank transfer on a checkout: By Raast or bank transfer on a checkout page. You submit the transaction reference, and the job goes live when Vacancyaan matches it to the bank record, usually the same working day. If it cannot be matched, you see why and can send a corrected reference.

By applying, or by accepting a venue’s i: By applying, or by accepting a venue’s invite. Until then the venue hears their voice introduction and sees their experience, never their number.
